ui.teamBridge.chief.unnamed.verdict: PASS all locales. Each reuses the namespace's settled chief-of-staff term (ui.teamBridge.chief.fallback: Cheffe de cabinet / Jefe de gabinete / 首席助理 / Координатор / Chánh văn phòng / چیف آف اسٹاف / चीफ़ ऑफ़ स्टाफ़; vi also matches the vi guide). fr and ru use the parenthesised '{term} ({person})' shape of ui.teamBridge.chief.label, which avoids de/d’ elision (fr) and declining arbitrary names into the genitive (ru); it names the owner once, so it does not repeat the person. es/zh-CN/vi/ur/hi use the natural possessive. ur/hi use masculine कا/کا to agree with the loan noun. {person} kept once in every locale; no bidi controls in ur (the render layer isolates).

ui.teamBridge.member.active_count.verdict: PASS (vi after A1). fr/es extend member.count with the agreeing adjective (actif/activo) and keep the 'many' + 'de' branch. ru: one/few/many/other agree (активный участник / активных участника / активных участников / активного участника for fractions). zh-CN: other only, classifier 名; 有效成员 means members whose membership is in force, and avoids 活跃 (activity). ur فعال رکن/ارکان and hi सक्रिय सदस्य are the standard 'active member' (membership standing) phrases. vi was 'đang hoạt động' (online-presence sense, against the context's 'not online presence'); fixed at 02eb623ac3 to 'đã tham gia' (joined), which also pairs with the invited line.

ui.teamBridge.member.invited_count.verdict: PASS (zh-CN, vi after A2/A3). fr invité / d’invités / invités and es invitado(s): compact substantive fragment, masculine generic, many branch with de. ru: substantivised participle, one приглашённый / few+many приглашённых / other приглашённого (correct for counted adjectival nouns). ur مدعو and hi आमंत्रित are invariant. zh-CN was '名已邀请' (classifier + active verb, 'who invited'); fixed to '名受邀成员'. vi was 'người được mời' ('person', but invitees may be agents); fixed to 'đã được mời'.
